desc: The ultra-compact DD PCC (pistol caliber carbine) SBR is a short-barreled AR15-style rifle that’s portable and highly maneuverable. It features an 8.3"Cold Hammer Forged barrel that’s extremely durable and provides great ballistics for the ubiquitous, cost-effective 9mm rounds fired. It may be compact and lightweight, but this rifle is feature-heavy and fully customizable, including having a free-floating, 7" DD4 rail with a popular M-LOK attachment for accommodating lights, sling mounts, or the vertical foregrip. The DD PCC SBR is mission-ready for a wide array of applications—without weighing down an operator. This rugged, reliable short-barreled rifle is built and backed by Daniel Defense, the most trusted name in firearms.
